The '''''Sontor Skipper''''' was an independent [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] that was owned and operated by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Ross (captain)|Ross]]. Ross and the ''Sontor Skipper'' were contracted by [[Aqualis Base]], an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] processing plant on [[Baralou]], to pick up a shipment of [[bestrum algae]] every twenty-three [[Local day/Legends|local days]].
